```{r}
inputs <- readRDS(params$inputs_path)
bundle_root <- dirname(dirname(params$inputs_path))
read_output <- function(name) {
  path <- inputs$outputs[[name]]
  if (is.null(path)) return(NULL)
  utils::read.csv(file.path(bundle_root, path), check.names = FALSE)
}
output_path <- function(name) {
  path <- inputs$outputs[[name]]
  if (is.null(path)) return(NULL)
  file.path(bundle_root, path)
}
module_record <- function(name) {
  inputs$module_status[[which(vapply(
    inputs$module_status,
    function(record) identical(record$module, name),
    logical(1)
  ))[[1L]]]]
}
status_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(inputs$module_status, function(record) {
  data.frame(
    analysis = gsub("_", " ", record$module),
    status = gsub("_", " ", record$status),
    resolution = gsub("_", " ", record$actual_resolution),
    explanation = if (is.null(record$reason)) {
      "Completed as specified."
    } else {
      record$reason
    },
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
```

## Ecological result

This run retained `r inputs$event_count` independent detection events from
`r inputs$physical_location_count` physical camera locations. The requested
spatial resolution was `r gsub("_", " ", inputs$resolution)` across
`r inputs$analysis_unit_count` analytical units.

```{r}
attention <- status_table[status_table$status != "completed", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(attention) > 0L) {
  knitr::kable(attention, caption = "Warnings and omitted analyses")
}
```

```{r}
effort <- read_output("effort_coverage")
richness <- read_output("observed_richness")
if (!is.null(effort)) {
  show <- effort[c(
    "analysis_unit_id", "confirmed_active_days", "unknown_days"
  )]
  if (!is.null(richness)) {
    show <- merge(
      show,
      richness[c("analysis_unit_id", "observed_richness")],
      by = "analysis_unit_id",
      all.x = TRUE,
      sort = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    show$observed_richness <- NA_integer_
  }
  show$eligible_for_community <- show$confirmed_active_days >= 1L
  names(show) <- c(
    "Analysis unit", "Confirmed active days", "Unknown days",
    "Observed species", "Included in community summaries"
  )
  knitr::kable(show)
}
```

Observed richness is the number of species detected in the supplied,
effort-filtered records. Units without a confirmed active day are excluded,
not treated as absences. A sampled unit with no detections has zero observed
richness. This is not an estimate of species that went undetected.

```{r}
jaccard <- read_output("jaccard")
if (!is.null(jaccard)) {
  finite <- jaccard$jaccard_dissimilarity[
    is.finite(jaccard$jaccard_dissimilarity)
  ]
  if (length(finite) > 0L) {
    cat(
      "Observed-composition Jaccard dissimilarity ranged from ",
      sprintf("%.3f", min(finite)), " to ", sprintf("%.3f", max(finite)),
      ".\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  } else {
    cat("No pairwise Jaccard value was estimable from the detected community.\n")
  }
}
```

Jaccard values describe turnover in detected composition. They are not
standardized for unequal effort, sampling completeness, or detectability and
do not establish environmental causes.

## Sampling context

The evidence contains `r inputs$operation_state_counts[["active"]]` confirmed
active analysis-unit days, `r inputs$operation_state_counts[["inactive"]]`
confirmed inactive days, and `r inputs$operation_state_counts[["unknown"]]`
days with unknown operation. Unknown operation was not counted as effort.

```{r}
rates <- read_output("operational_event_detection_rate")
if (!is.null(rates) && nrow(rates) > 0L) {
  rates <- rates[order(
    rates$events_per_100_active_days,
    decreasing = TRUE,
    na.last = TRUE
  ), ]
  show <- utils::head(rates, 15L)
  names(show) <- c(
    "Physical location", "Species", "Events", "Confirmed active days",
    "Events per 100 active days"
  )
  knitr::kable(show, digits = 2)
}
```

Operational-event detection rates describe detections per confirmed active
camera day. They must not be interpreted as abundance or density.

### Coarse day and night

```{r}
diel <- read_output("coarse_day_night")
if (!is.null(diel) && nrow(diel) > 0L) {
  names(diel) <- c(
    "Physical location", "Species", "Period", "Events", "Proportion"
  )
  knitr::kable(diel, digits = 3)
} else {
  cat(module_record("coarse_day_night")$reason)
}
```

## Analysis status

```{r}
knitr::kable(status_table)
```

An omitted analysis lacked the evidence needed for a defensible result. A
completed-with-warnings result remains usable within the explanation shown
above. Detailed source, repair, entity, effort, event-membership, configuration,
and fixity evidence is kept separately in the audit bundle.

## Limits

- Camera-trap non-detection does not prove ecological absence.
- Coarse day/night categories do not support fine-scale diel inference.
- Species accumulation describes sampling accumulation, not unseen richness.
- Point maps show supplied physical locations and do not interpolate habitat.
- No result in this report estimates abundance, density, population trend, or
  causal habitat response.
